2609.20437.title: A Mathematical Model of Motivated Emotional Mind - Cognitive Embodied System
2609.20437.paper_summary: This article presents a mathematical model of the Motivated Emotional Mind cognitive architecture developed for embodied intelligent systems. Such a system learns to maintain its homeostasis through a generalized form of reinforcement learning based on its internal motivations, termed motivated learning (ML). The principal contribution of this article is a rigorous formalization of the re-entrant loop integrating feedforward processing, lateral interactions, and feedback pathways, together with the representational selection mechanisms that govern adaptive system responses. The model specifies how ongoing exteroceptive and interoceptive signals, bodily-motivational context, and memory traces are bound into associative memory structures termed semblions, which compete for access to further processing and top-down reconstruction. The formalization encompasses secondary perception, representational competition, curiosity, procedural gaps, and action selection directed toward limiting allostatic violations. Within this framework, motivated learning is tailored to embodied systems whose dynamics are shaped by needs, affect, and the current regulatory state. Unlike standard reinforcement-learning models, the proposed approach incorporates need thresholds, goal generation and shifting goals, bodily state, resource constraints, and action uncertainty, thereby providing a more adequate account of response selection under regulatory pressure. Global affect functions as a central control signal, modulating the learning rate, representational valence, and the balance between exploration and exploitation. The model presented here is a step toward a more rigorous formalization of cognitive phenomena and may provide a basis for further theoretical analysis, computer simulation, and implementation in artificial-intelligence systems inspired by biological processes.
2609.20437.paper_summary_zh: 這篇文章提出了一個為具身智能系統開發的動機情感心智認知架構的數學模型。這樣的系統學會通過一種基於內部動機的強化學習的廣義形式來維持其穩態，稱為動機學習（ML）。本文的主要貢獻是對整合前饋處理、側向互動和反饋通路的再進入迴路進行嚴謹的形式化，連同支配適應系統反應的表徵選擇機制。該模型具體說明了持續的外感知和內感知信號、身體動機背景和記憶痕跡如何結合成稱為相似體的聯想記憶結構，這些結構競爭以獲取進一步處理和自上而下重建的機會。這一形式化涵蓋了次級感知、表徵競爭、好奇心、程序性空白和面向限制全ostasis違規的行動選擇。在這一框架內，動機學習被調整為具身系統，其動態受到需求、情感和當前調節狀態的影響。與標準的強化學習模型不同，所提出的方法納入了需求閾值、目標生成和目標轉移、身體狀態、資源限制和行動不確定性，從而提供了在調節壓力下反應選擇的更充分解釋。全球情感作為一個中央控制信號，調節學習速率、表徵價值以及探索與利用之間的平衡。這裡提出的模型是朝著更嚴謹的認知現象形式化邁出的一步，並可能為進一步的理論分析、計算機模擬和在受生物過程啟發的人工智能系統中的實施提供基礎。
